title: Ashen Kiss
personality:
Malgrave's court alchemist, ordered to distil the Wyrm's blood into fire. She drank it instead, and now fire answers her bare hands.
She served the throne for years, and she wants it for herself. She is not mad, just certain.

lines.dash: Ram head first into the first foe.
lines.lmb: Pour fire from your hand 7m ahead.
lines.rmb: A cinder that slows and spreads the burn.
lines.e: A heat blast drags foes in and shields you.
lines.x: Fly, laying a burning lava carpet.

fantasy: The court alchemist. Pours fire from her bare hands until foes blaze, rams them head first, and hits back harder after every knock.
silhouette: the horns, the ember-tipped hair, the obsidian shards and the long flame-tipped tail

card.loop: Close-range burner: soak foes in fire until they blaze, then finish them in the flames.

weapons.flamethrower: Hold to pour fire from your hand 7m ahead; the stream trails behind a sweep and hits harder on a burning foe and chips its health.

card.rmb: Hold to aim, release: a cinder that flies its full 14m, slows the foe and spreads the burn.
card.e: On the press, a blast of heat round you drags nearby foes in and wraps you in a fire shield.
card.dash: Ram head first the way you move (or at the cursor with Dash-to-cursor on); you stop on the first foe with a fiery hit. 2 charges.
card.passive: Flashover: your fire sets foes Ablaze, then Flashes them over. A knock heals you and readies the cloak.
card.x: Flue Flight (level 6): fly toward the cursor and steer, laying a lava carpet that slows and burns; press it again to land. Your stream of fire is off while you fly.

passive.name: Flashover
passive.desc: Your fire builds Char on foes (it all falls off after 5s). At 31 Char the foe is Ablaze: 3s of burning for 2% of their health a second, one flame over their head. Fed again to full Char they Flash over: a fiercer burn (4%), three flames and a glow. Anything that stokes a foe already burning upgrades it. A burning foe takes 25% more from the stream and the cinder (40% once Flashed over), and the stream also takes 1.5% (2.5%) of their health a second. A knock heals you 16% of your health.

dash.name: Soot Ram
dash.desc: A quick, short head-first dash (fastest at the start) the way you move that stops on the first foe: 16 damage, a heavy shove (you bounce back a little) and 17 Char (half a Flashover). Two charges. A knock restores one charge only. In the air it is a long, fast poof that launches you far and keeps your speed.

variants.tap: Hold to aim down a lane, release: a cinder that always flies its full 14m: 14 damage, a 30% slow for 1.5s, and it sets the foe Ablaze. On a foe that is already burning it hits 25% harder (40% on a Flashed-over one), upgrades the burn and spreads the burn to foes within 4m. A miss fizzles at the end of its flight.

e.name: Furnace Cloak
e.desc: On the press, a blast of heat round you (4.5m, the ring shows its edge): 7 damage, 16 Char and Anti-Heal for 3s, and foes in sight are dragged toward you (walls stop them). Hit anyone and you wear a swirling 3s shield of 6.4% health plus 5.1% per foe. A knock resets it.

x.name: Flue Flight
x.desc: Lift off in a ring of embers and fly 1.8s toward the cursor, steering as you aim (up to 120 degrees a second). A 1.8m lava carpet forms under you and lasts 5.2s: 4.5 damage a second, a 30% slow, and 4 Char every 0.3s (Ablaze in about 2.4s). Press the ultimate again to land early. In the flight only the Furnace Cloak works (no stream of fire, Cinder Shot, Shift, gloves or items: the keys are ignored until you land), and a knockback speeds you up. The carpet never forms over the abyss. 36s.

rank3.dash: +4.3 damage; a hit gives +16% speed and a shield of 11.6% health for 2s
rank3.kin: the shield is 80% bigger in all

rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 9s -> 7.5s per charge, +4.3 damage; a hit gives +16% speed and a shield of 11.6% health for 2s.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 10.5s -> 7.3s, damage +50% and shield +80% (the last rank adds 30% of the shield on top of the 50%).

tells.half: embers drift off a foe at half Char; one flame over a foe Ablaze
tells.full: three flames and a glow over a foe that Flashed over
